title: The Animal That Regrows Its Limbs
hook: A lost limb can grow back, if you are an axolotl.
script: A lost limb can grow back, if you are an axolotl. An axolotl regrows a whole missing leg in 40 to 50 days. Bone, muscle and nerves all return, without scarring. So why can't a person do this? A human wound seals with scar tissue, but its cells reset and rebuild the missing part. It can even repair its spinal cord, and parts of its heart and brain. That is why labs around the world keep colonies of them alive. Has anyone made a human limb regrow yet? Not once. Is the inability of mammals to regrow limbs a hard biological limit, or a switch nobody has found yet?
